title: Moving to Harlem and changing schools
summary: His aunt moved to West 131st Street, near the Lafayette Theater and the Rhythm Club, which meant a new school and gang.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth
